lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: Zimmer Biomet posted a solid Q3 beat and raised its full-year organic growth and EPS guidance. While the knee segment remains a transition point, the company's diversification into hips and high-growth technology/data (up 12%) is effectively offsetting headwinds. Shares saw a significant 13% upward re-rating following the print.
providers.risk: Execution risks related to an ongoing salesforce transformation and slower-than-expected recovery in the knee implant market.
